verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová a Moisés:

verses.original: צַ֞ו אֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְיִקְח֨וּ אֵלֶ֜יךָ שֶׁ֣מֶן זַ֥יִת זָ֛ךְ כָּתִ֖ית לַמָּא֑וֹר לְהַעֲלֹ֥ת נֵ֖ר תָּמִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: ṣaw ’eṯ- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·yiq·ḥū ’ê·le·ḵā še·men za·yiṯ zāḵ kā·ṯîṯ lam·mā·’ō·wr lə·ha·‘ă·lōṯ nêr tā·mîḏ
verses.literal: Command the Israelites . . . to bring you pure oil of pressed olives for the light to keep the lamps burning continually
verses.literalPt: Ordena aos filhos de Israel que te tragam azeite puro de oliveira, espremido num gral, para o candeeiro, para fazer arder uma lâmpada continuamente.

verses.original: מִחוּץ֩ לְפָרֹ֨כֶת הָעֵדֻ֜ת בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֗ד יַעֲרֹךְ֩ אֹת֨וֹ אַהֲרֹ֜ן מֵעֶ֧רֶב עַד־ בֹּ֛קֶר לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה תָּמִ֑יד חֻקַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם לְדֹרֹֽתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: mi·ḥūṣ lə·p̄ā·rō·ḵeṯ hā·‘ê·ḏuṯ bə·’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ ya·‘ă·rōḵ ’ō·ṯōw ’a·hă·rōn mê·‘e·reḇ ‘aḏ- bō·qer lip̄·nê Yah·weh tā·mîḏ ḥuq·qaṯ ‘ō·w·lām lə·ḏō·rō·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: Outside the veil of the Testimony in the Tent of Meeting Aaron is to tend the lamps continually before the LORD from evening until morning This is to be a permanent statute for the generations to come
verses.literalPt: Fora do véu do Testemunho, na tenda da revelação colocá-la-á Arão diante de Jeová continuamente, desde a tarde até pela manhã: será um estatuto perpétuo pelas vossas gerações.

verses.original: עַ֚ל הַמְּנֹרָ֣ה הַטְּהֹרָ֔ה יַעֲרֹ֖ךְ אֶת־ הַנֵּר֑וֹת לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה תָּמִֽיד׃פ
verses.transliteration: ‘al ham·mə·nō·rāh haṭ·ṭə·hō·rāh ya·‘ă·rōḵ ’eṯ- han·nê·rō·wṯ lip̄·nê Yah·weh tā·mîḏ
verses.literal: He shall tend the lamps on the pure gold lampstand before the LORD continually
verses.literalPt: Sobre o candeeiro puro colocará as lâmpadas diante de Jeová continuamente.

verses.original: וְלָקַחְתָּ֣ סֹ֔לֶת וְאָפִיתָ֣ אֹתָ֔הּ שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה חַלּ֑וֹת שְׁנֵי֙ עֶשְׂרֹנִ֔ים יִהְיֶ֖ה הַֽחַלָּ֥ה הָאֶחָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ·tā sō·leṯ wə·’ā·p̄î·ṯā ’ō·ṯāh šə·têm ‘eś·rêh ḥal·lō·wṯ šə·nê ‘eś·rō·nîm yih·yeh ha·ḥal·lāh hā·’e·ḥāṯ
verses.literal: You are also to take fine flour and bake twelve . . . loaves using two-tenths of an ephah . . . for each loaf
verses.literalPt: Também tomarás flor de farinha e dela cozerás doze pães, cada um dos quais terá duas dízimas de um efa.

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתָּ֥ אוֹתָ֛ם שְׁתַּ֥יִם מַֽעֲרָכ֖וֹת שֵׁ֣שׁ הַֽמַּעֲרָ֑כֶת עַ֛ל הַשֻּׁלְחָ֥ן הַטָּהֹ֖ר לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·śam·tā ’ō·w·ṯām šə·ta·yim ma·‘ă·rā·ḵō·wṯ šêš ham·ma·‘ă·rā·ḵeṯ ‘al haš·šul·ḥān haṭ·ṭā·hōr lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: and set them in two rows six per row on the table of pure gold before the LORD
verses.literalPt: Pô-los-ás sobre a mesa para diante de Jeová, em duas fileiras, seis em cada fileira.

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּ֥ עַל־ הַֽמַּעֲרֶ֖כֶת לְבֹנָ֣ה זַכָּ֑ה וְהָיְתָ֤ה לַלֶּ֙חֶם֙ לְאַזְכָּרָ֔ה אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯa·tā ‘al- ham·ma·‘ă·re·ḵeṯ lə·ḇō·nāh zak·kāh wə·hā·yə·ṯāh lal·le·ḥem lə·’az·kā·rāh ’iš·šeh Yah·weh
verses.literal: And you are to place pure frankincense near each row so that it may serve as a memorial portion for the bread a food offering to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Porás sobre cada fileira incenso puro, a fim de que seja sobre o pão como memorial, isto é, como oferta queimada a Jeová.

verses.original: בְּי֨וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֜ת בְּי֣וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֗ת יַֽעַרְכֶ֛נּוּ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה תָּמִ֑יד מֵאֵ֥ת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּרִ֥ית עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: bə·yō·wm haš·šab·bāṯ bə·yō·wm haš·šab·bāṯ ya·‘ar·ḵen·nū lip̄·nê Yah·weh tā·mîḏ mê·’êṯ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl bə·rîṯ ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: Every Sabbath day . . . . . . . . . the bread is to be set out before the LORD . . . . . . on behalf of the Israelites as a permanent covenant
verses.literalPt: Todos os sábados, serão dispostos diante de Jeová continuamente; é a favor dos filhos de Israel um estatuto perpétuo.

verses.original: וְהָֽיְתָה֙ לְאַהֲרֹ֣ן וּלְבָנָ֔יו וַאֲכָלֻ֖הוּ בְּמָק֣וֹם קָדֹ֑שׁ כִּ֡י קֹדֶשׁ֩ קָֽדָשִׁ֨ים ה֥וּא ל֛וֹ מֵאִשֵּׁ֥י יְהוָ֖ה חָק־ עוֹלָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yə·ṯāh lə·’a·hă·rōn ū·lə·ḇā·nāw wa·’ă·ḵā·lu·hū bə·mā·qō·wm qā·ḏōš kî qō·ḏeš qā·ḏā·šîm hū lōw mê·’iš·šê Yah·weh ḥāq- ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: It belongs to Aaron and his sons who are to eat it in a holy place for it is to him a most holy part of the food offerings to the LORD his portion forever
verses.literalPt: Pertencerão a Arão e a seus filhos; eles os comerão num lugar santo, pois são para ele coisa santíssima das ofertas queimadas, de Jeová, por estatuto perpétuo.

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵא֙ בֶּן־ אִשָּׁ֣ה יִשְׂרְאֵלִ֔ית וְהוּא֙ בֶּן־ אִ֣ישׁ מִצְרִ֔י בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּנָּצוּ֙ בַּֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה בֶּ֚ן הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִ֔ית וְאִ֖ישׁ הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê ben- ’iš·šāh yiś·rə·’ê·lîṯ wə·hū ben- ’îš miṣ·rî bə·ṯō·wḵ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·yin·nā·ṣū bam·ma·ḥă·neh ben hay·yiś·rə·’ê·lîṯ wə·’îš hay·yiś·rə·’ê·lî
verses.literal: Now the son of an Israelite . . . mother and an Egyptian father went out among the Israelites and a fight broke out in the camp between him . . . and an Israelite
verses.literalPt: Dentre os filhos de Israel saiu o filho duma mulher israelita, o qual teve por pai um egípcio. Houve uma contenda no arraial entre o filho da mulher israelita e um homem de Israel;

verses.original: וַ֠יִּקֹּב בֶּן־ הָֽאִשָּׁ֨ה הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִ֤ית אֶת־ הַשֵּׁם֙ וַיְקַלֵּ֔ל וַיָּבִ֥יאוּ אֹת֖וֹ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֑ה וְשֵׁ֥ם אִמּ֛וֹ שְׁלֹמִ֥ית בַּת־ דִּבְרִ֖י לְמַטֵּה־ דָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qōḇ ben- hā·’iš·šāh hay·yiś·rə·’ê·lîṯ ’eṯ- haš·šêm way·qal·lêl way·yā·ḇî·’ū ’ō·ṯōw ’el- mō·šeh wə·šêm ’im·mōw šə·lō·mîṯ baṯ- diḇ·rî lə·maṭ·ṭêh- ḏān
verses.literal: The son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name with a curse So they brought him to Moses (His mother’s name was Shelomith daughter of Dibri of the tribe of Dan
verses.literalPt: o filho da mulher israelita blasfemou o Nome e praguejou. Trouxeram-no a Moisés. Ora, o nome de sua mãe era Selomite, filha de Dibri, da tribo de Dã.

verses.original: וַיַּנִּיחֻ֖הוּ בַּמִּשְׁמָ֑ר לִפְרֹ֥שׁ לָהֶ֖ם עַל־ פִּ֥י יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yan·nî·ḥu·hū bam·miš·mār lip̄·rōš lā·hem ‘al- pî Yah·weh
verses.literal: They placed him in custody until the will of the LORD should be made clear to them . . .
verses.literalPt: Puseram-no em prisão, para que viesse a sentença da boca de Jeová.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová a Moisés:

verses.original: הוֹצֵ֣א אֶת־ הַֽמְקַלֵּ֗ל אֶל־ מִחוּץ֙ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וְסָמְכ֧וּ כָֽל־ הַשֹּׁמְעִ֛ים אֶת־ יְדֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־ רֹאשׁ֑וֹ וְרָגְמ֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ כָּל־ הָעֵדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w·ṣê ’eṯ- ham·qal·lêl ’el- mi·ḥūṣ lam·ma·ḥă·neh wə·sā·mə·ḵū ḵāl haš·šō·mə·‘îm ’eṯ- yə·ḏê·hem ‘al- rō·šōw wə·rā·ḡə·mū ’ō·ṯōw kāl- hā·‘ê·ḏāh
verses.literal: Take the blasphemer outside the camp and have all who heard him lay their hands on his head then have the whole assembly stone him
verses.literalPt: Tira o que blasfemou para fora do arraial; todos os que o ouviram porão as mãos sobre a cabeça dele, e toda a congregação o apedrejará.

verses.original: וְאֶל־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל תְּדַבֵּ֣ר לֵאמֹ֑ר אִ֥ישׁ אִ֛ישׁ כִּֽי־ יְקַלֵּ֥ל אֱלֹהָ֖יו וְנָשָׂ֥א חֶטְאֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl tə·ḏab·bêr lê·mōr ’îš ’îš kî- yə·qal·lêl ’ĕ·lō·hāw wə·nā·śā ḥeṭ·’ōw
verses.literal: And you are to tell . . . the Israelites . . . If anyone . . . curses his God he shall bear the consequences of his sin
verses.literalPt: Dirás aos filhos de Israel: Todo homem que amaldiçoar ao seu Deus, levará sobre si o seu pecado.

verses.original: וְנֹקֵ֤ב שֵׁם־ יְהוָה֙ מ֣וֹת יוּמָ֔ת רָג֥וֹם יִרְגְּמוּ־ ב֖וֹ כָּל־ הָעֵדָ֑ה כַּגֵּר֙ כָּֽאֶזְרָ֔ח בְּנָקְבוֹ־ שֵׁ֖ם יוּמָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nō·qêḇ šêm- Yah·weh mō·wṯ yū·māṯ rā·ḡō·wm yir·gə·mū- ḇōw kāl- hā·‘ê·ḏāh kag·gêr kā·’ez·rāḥ bə·nā·qə·ḇōw- šêm yū·māṯ
verses.literal: Whoever blasphemes the name of the LORD must surely be put to death . . . the whole assembly must surely stone . . . him whether he is a foreign resident or native if he blasphemes the Name he must be put to death
verses.literalPt: Aquele que blasfemar o nome de Jeová certamente será morto; toda a congregação o apedrejará. Será morto tanto o estrangeiro como o natural, quando blasfemar o Nome.

verses.original: וְאִ֕ישׁ כִּ֥י יַכֶּ֖ה כָּל־ נֶ֣פֶשׁ אָדָ֑ם מ֖וֹת יוּמָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš kî yak·keh kāl- ne·p̄eš ’ā·ḏām mō·wṯ yū·māṯ
verses.literal: And if a man takes the life of anyone else . . . . . . he must surely be put to death . . .
verses.literalPt: Quem matar a alguém certamente será morto;

verses.original: וּמַכֵּ֥ה נֶֽפֶשׁ־ בְּהֵמָ֖ה יְשַׁלְּמֶ֑נָּה נֶ֖פֶשׁ תַּ֥חַת נָֽפֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mak·kêh ne·p̄eš- bə·hê·māh yə·šal·lə·men·nāh ne·p̄eš ta·ḥaṯ nā·p̄eš
verses.literal: Whoever kills an animal must make restitution life for . . . life
verses.literalPt: e quem matar a um animal por este fará restituição: vida por vida.

verses.original: וְאִ֕ישׁ כִּֽי־ יִתֵּ֥ן מ֖וּם בַּעֲמִית֑וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה כֵּ֖ן יֵעָ֥שֶׂה לּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš kî- yit·tên mūm ba·‘ă·mî·ṯōw ka·’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh kên yê·‘ā·śeh lōw
verses.literal: If anyone injures . . . his neighbor whatever he has done . . . must be done to him
verses.literalPt: Se alguém causar um defeito em seu próximo, como fez, assim se lhe fará a ele:

verses.original: שֶׁ֚בֶר תַּ֣חַת שֶׁ֔בֶר עַ֚יִן תַּ֣חַת עַ֔יִן שֵׁ֖ן תַּ֣חַת שֵׁ֑ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר יִתֵּ֥ן מוּם֙ בָּֽאָדָ֔ם כֵּ֖ן יִנָּ֥תֶן בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: še·b̲er ta·ḥaṯ še·ḇer ‘a·yin ta·ḥaṯ ‘a·yin šên ta·ḥaṯ šên ka·’ă·šer yit·tên mūm bā·’ā·ḏām kên yin·nā·ṯen bōw
verses.literal: fracture for fracture eye for eye tooth for tooth Just as he injured . . . the other person the same must be inflicted on him
verses.literalPt: quebradura por quebradura, olho por olho, dente por dente; como causou um defeito num homem, assim se lhe retribuirá a ele.

verses.original: וּמַכֵּ֥ה בְהֵמָ֖ה יְשַׁלְּמֶ֑נָּה וּמַכֵּ֥ה אָדָ֖ם יוּמָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mak·kêh ḇə·hê·māh yə·šal·lə·men·nāh ū·mak·kêh ’ā·ḏām yū·māṯ
verses.literal: Whoever kills an animal must make restitution but whoever kills a man must be put to death
verses.literalPt: Quem matar a um animal por este fará restituição; quem matar a um homem certamente será morto.

verses.original: מִשְׁפַּ֤ט אֶחָד֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם כַּגֵּ֥ר כָּאֶזְרָ֖ח יִהְיֶ֑ה כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: miš·paṭ ’e·ḥāḏ yih·yeh lā·ḵem kag·gêr kā·’ez·rāḥ yih·yeh kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: You are to have the same standard of law for the foreign resident and the native . . . for I am the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: Uma e a mesma lei tereis, tanto para o estrangeiro como para o natural; pois eu sou Jeová, vosso Deus.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר מֹשֶׁה֮ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַיּוֹצִ֣יאוּ אֶת־ הַֽמְקַלֵּ֗ל אֶל־ מִחוּץ֙ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וַיִּרְגְּמ֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ אָ֑בֶן וּבְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עָשׂ֔וּ כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr mō·šeh ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·yō·w·ṣî·’ū ’eṯ- ham·qal·lêl ’el- mi·ḥūṣ lam·ma·ḥă·neh way·yir·gə·mū ’ō·ṯōw ’ā·ḇen ū·ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ‘ā·śū ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh
verses.literal: Then Moses spoke to the Israelites . . . and they took the blasphemer outside the camp and stoned him So the Israelites . . . did as the LORD had commanded Moses
verses.literalPt: Então, falou Moisés aos filhos de Israel; eles tiraram aquele que praguejara para fora do arraial e o apedrejaram. Fizeram os filhos de Israel como Jeová ordenou a Moisés.
